title: Resolve 502 Bad Gateway errors on the API
content: Intermittent 502 errors usually indicate the upstream service is restarting or hitting a connection limit. Check the load balancer health checks, confirm the backend pool has at least two healthy targets, and inspect upstream timeout settings. Increase the gateway read timeout to 30s if backends are slow under load.

title: Webhook delivery retries and exponential backoff
content: Failed webhook deliveries are retried up to 8 times with exponential backoff starting at 5 seconds. After the final retry the event is marked failed and visible in the Webhooks dashboard. Re-deliver manually from the Events page, and ensure your endpoint returns a 2xx status within 10 seconds to avoid timeouts.

title: API rate limits and 429 handling
content: The default rate limit is 100 requests per second per API key. Exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Implement client-side backoff that honors Retry-After. Request a higher limit from support if your workload is sustained above the default.

title: Rotating and revoking API keys
content: Create a new API key under Settings > API Keys before revoking the old one to avoid downtime. Update the key in your environment, deploy, then revoke the previous key. Revocation takes effect within 60 seconds across all regions.

title: Configuring SSO with SAML
content: Upload your identity provider metadata XML under Settings > Security > SSO. Map the email attribute to NameID and assign default roles. Test with a single user before enforcing SSO for the whole organization. JIT provisioning creates users on first login.

title: Troubleshooting login failures after password reset
content: If users cannot log in after a password reset, confirm the reset link was used within 1 hour and that the new password meets the 12-character policy. Clear cached credentials and check whether SSO is enforced, which disables password login. Locked accounts unlock automatically after 15 minutes.

title: CSV export returns empty files
content: Empty CSV exports usually mean the selected date range has no records or a filter excludes all rows. Verify the timezone of the date filter and that the report has finished generating. Large exports are emailed as a download link rather than streamed in the browser.

title: Dashboard loads slowly in the browser
content: Slow dashboard loads are often caused by very large saved views or browser extensions. Reduce the default date range, disable ad blockers for the app domain, and clear the local cache. Chrome users should confirm hardware acceleration is enabled.

title: Diagnosing regional integration outages
content: To determine whether an outage is regional, check the status page for the affected region and compare error rates across regions in the metrics dashboard. Confirm DNS resolves to the correct regional endpoint. If only one region is affected, failover by updating the endpoint in your client configuration.

title: Securing API keys in your application
content: Store API keys in environment variables or a secrets manager, never in source control. Use separate keys per environment and scope keys to the minimum permissions required. Rotate keys quarterly and immediately if a leak is suspected.

title: Webhook signature verification
content: Every webhook includes an HMAC-SHA256 signature in the X-Signature header computed over the raw request body using your signing secret. Verify the signature before processing and reject mismatches. Use a constant-time comparison to avoid timing attacks.

title: Handling timeouts on webhook integrations
content: If your webhook integration fails with timeout errors, ensure your endpoint responds within 10 seconds and offloads heavy processing to a background queue. Persistent timeouts cause the event to be retried and eventually marked failed. Monitor your endpoint latency and scale horizontally if needed.

title: Enabling two-factor authentication
content: Users enable 2FA under Profile > Security using an authenticator app. Admins can enforce 2FA org-wide under Settings > Security. Recovery codes are shown once at setup and must be stored safely; lost codes require admin reset.

title: Pagination and cursor-based listing
content: List endpoints return up to 100 items per page and a next_cursor token. Pass the cursor as the starting_after parameter to fetch the next page. Do not rely on offset pagination for large datasets, as it is deprecated and slower.

title: Configuring custom domains
content: Add your custom domain under Settings > Domains and create the displayed CNAME record at your DNS provider. Verification can take up to 24 hours. TLS certificates are provisioned automatically once the CNAME resolves.

title: Debugging missing webhook events
content: If expected webhook events are missing, confirm the event type is subscribed in your endpoint configuration and that the endpoint is enabled. Check the delivery log for 4xx responses indicating your server rejected the event. Disabled endpoints stop receiving events after 3 consecutive days of failures.

title: Understanding duplicate charges
content: A duplicate charge can occur if a payment is retried after a network timeout. Compare the charge IDs and timestamps; identical amounts seconds apart usually indicate a retry. Refund the duplicate and confirm idempotency keys are used to prevent recurrence.

title: How refunds are processed
content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method and typically settle in 5-10 business days. Partial refunds are supported up to the original charge amount. Refunds above $500 require manager approval before processing.

title: Invoice amount changed between months
content: Invoice totals change due to proration when plans are upgraded or downgraded mid-cycle, added seats, or usage-based charges. Review the line items on the invoice for proration entries. Taxes are recalculated based on the billing address.

title: Updating your payment method
content: Update your card under Settings > Billing > Payment Methods. The new card is validated with a temporary authorization that is reversed immediately. Set a card as default to use it for the next invoice; expired cards trigger a dunning email.

title: Subscription auto-renewal and cancellation
content: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing cycle unless cancelled. Cancelling stops the next renewal but retains access until the period ends. There is no proration for mid-cycle cancellation on monthly plans.

title: Failed payment and dunning process
content: When a payment fails, we retry on days 1, 3, 5, and 7 and send dunning emails. After the final retry the subscription moves to past_due and access is restricted. Update the payment method to retry immediately and restore access.

title: Applying discount and coupon codes
content: Enter approved coupon codes at checkout or under Settings > Billing. Only codes from the approved list are valid; expired or invalid codes are rejected. Discounts apply to the next invoice and stack only when explicitly allowed.

title: Proration on plan upgrades
content: Upgrading mid-cycle charges a prorated amount for the remaining days at the new rate and credits unused time on the old plan. The proration appears as separate line items on the next invoice. Downgrades take effect at the next cycle.

title: Refund status verification
content: To confirm whether a refund has been issued, look up the charge in the Billing dashboard and check for a linked refund object with status succeeded. Pending refunds show as processing. Provide the charge ID to support for faster lookup.

title: Tax and VAT handling on invoices
content: Taxes are calculated based on your billing address and applicable local rules. Add your VAT or tax ID under Settings > Billing to apply reverse charge where eligible. Tax-exempt organizations must upload an exemption certificate for review.

title: Seat-based billing and adding users
content: Seat-based plans bill per active user. Adding a seat mid-cycle is prorated; removing a seat credits the unused portion at the next invoice. Deactivated users free their seat immediately but historical data is retained.

title: Chargeback and dispute handling
content: When a customer files a chargeback, the disputed amount is held and we request evidence. Respond within the deadline shown in the dashboard with order details and communication logs. Losing a dispute incurs a fee in addition to the refunded amount.

title: Annual vs monthly billing
content: Annual plans are billed once per year at a discount compared to monthly. Switching from monthly to annual takes effect immediately with proration. Annual plans renew automatically unless cancelled before the renewal date.

title: Reading the billing usage report
content: The usage report breaks down metered charges by product and day. Export it as CSV for reconciliation. Usage is aggregated in UTC and finalized at the end of the cycle, so mid-cycle figures are estimates.

title: When to escalate to a human agent
content: Escalate when the issue involves potential data loss, a security incident, a refund above $500, suspected fraud, or an SLA breach. Provide a structured summary including customer ID, impact, and steps already taken so the on-call engineer can act quickly.

title: Security incident response runbook
content: On a suspected security incident, immediately rotate affected credentials, isolate the impacted service, and notify the security on-call channel. Preserve logs for forensics and do not communicate details over unencrypted channels. Open a formal incident with a timeline.

title: SLA tiers and response times
content: Standard tier targets a 24-hour first response, Premium 4 hours, and Enterprise 1 hour for critical issues. Critical means production down or major data risk. SLA timers pause while waiting on customer input.

title: Suspected fraud handling
content: If fraud is suspected on an account, place charges on hold, avoid issuing refunds until verified, and escalate to the trust and safety team. Collect the charge IDs, IP addresses, and account history. Do not disclose internal fraud signals to the customer.

title: Writing a good escalation summary
content: An effective escalation summary states the customer impact, affected customer and tenant IDs, reproduction steps, what was already tried, and the requested outcome. Keep it under 200 words and link relevant tickets and logs.

title: Data deletion and GDPR requests
content: Process data deletion requests by verifying the requester's identity and confirming there is no legal hold. Deletion is irreversible and propagates to backups within 30 days. Provide written confirmation once complete.

title: Production outage communication
content: During a production outage, post an initial status update within 15 minutes, then updates every 30 minutes until resolved. Use neutral, factual language and avoid speculating on root cause publicly. Publish a postmortem within 5 business days.

title: Getting started with the API
content: Generate an API key under Settings > API Keys and authenticate with a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Start with the GET /v1/account endpoint to verify connectivity. All requests use HTTPS and JSON bodies.

title: Supported integrations overview
content: We integrate natively with Slack, Zendesk, Salesforce, Stripe, and Intercom. Configure each under Settings > Integrations using OAuth. Custom integrations are possible via the REST API and webhooks.

title: Role-based access control basics
content: Roles are Owner, Admin, Member, and Viewer. Owners manage billing and security, Admins manage users and settings, Members use the product, and Viewers have read-only access. Assign the least privilege necessary.

title: Audit logs and activity history
content: Audit logs record security-relevant actions like logins, role changes, and API key creation. Filter by user, action, and date under Settings > Audit Log. Logs are retained for 1 year and exportable on Enterprise plans.

title: Notification and email preferences
content: Manage which events trigger emails under Profile > Notifications. Org-wide defaults are set by admins. Critical security notifications cannot be disabled. Add your domain to your allowlist to ensure delivery.

title: Mobile app offline behavior
content: The mobile app caches recently viewed data for offline access and syncs when connectivity returns. Edits made offline are queued and may conflict; the most recent change wins. Force a sync from the app settings if data looks stale.

title: Importing data via CSV
content: Use the CSV import wizard under Settings > Import. Match your columns to the required fields and validate a sample before running the full import. Imports above 50,000 rows are processed asynchronously with an email confirmation.

title: Browser and device compatibility
content: The app supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported. For best performance use a device with at least 8 GB of RAM and a current OS.

title: Configuring webhook endpoints
content: Add a webhook endpoint under Settings > Webhooks, choose the events to subscribe to, and save the signing secret. Test delivery with the Send Test Event button. Use HTTPS endpoints only; plain HTTP is rejected.

title: Handling clock skew in API requests
content: Requests with timestamps more than 5 minutes from server time are rejected to prevent replay attacks. Synchronize your server clock with NTP. Signature verification depends on accurate timestamps.

title: Bulk operations and async jobs
content: Bulk create and update operations return a job ID. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{id} for status and results. Jobs are retained for 7 days. Large jobs are rate limited to protect shared infrastructure.

title: Sandbox vs production environments
content: Use the sandbox environment for testing with separate API keys and seeded test data. No real charges are made in sandbox. Promote configuration to production manually; data does not transfer between environments.

title: Understanding idempotency keys
content: Pass an Idempotency-Key header on POST requests to safely retry without creating duplicates. The same key returns the original response for 24 hours. Use a unique key per logical operation, such as a UUID.

title: Exporting and backing up account data
content: Owners can request a full account export under Settings > Data Export. The export is prepared asynchronously and delivered as a downloadable archive valid for 48 hours. Schedule regular exports for compliance backups.

title: Managing team invitations
content: Invite teammates by email under Settings > Members. Invitations expire after 7 days and can be resent. Pending invitations do not consume a billing seat until accepted.

title: Resolving sync conflicts in integrations
content: When a two-way integration reports a sync conflict, the system keeps the most recently updated record and logs the discarded version. Review conflicts in the integration log and re-map fields if conflicts are frequent. Disable two-way sync to make one source authoritative.
